description: This file defines a class ArizePhoenixLogger for integrating Arize Phoenix with OpenTelemetry, including configuration retrieval from environment variables, setting span attributes, and performing health checks.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixLogger
classes.description: A logger class for Arize Phoenix that extends OpenTelemetry, providing methods to set attributes and retrieve configuration.

methods.name: set_attributes
methods.description: Sets attributes on a span, including Arize Phoenix specific attributes.

methods.name: set_arize_phoenix_attributes
methods.description: Static method to set Arize Phoenix specific attributes on a span, including project name.

methods.name: get_arize_phoenix_config
methods.description: Retrieves the Arize Phoenix configuration from environment variables, determining endpoint, protocol, and authentication headers.

methods.name: async_health_check
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check to verify if the Arize Phoenix credentials are properly configured.
